library_category.instructions: Which category of the technical library does this request best match?

criteria.languages: language syntax, types, ownership, closures, event loop, concurrency and standard libraries
criteria.algorithms: algorithms, graphs, trees, heaps, sorting, searching, data structures and complexity
criteria.architecture: architecture, DDD, domain ownership, design patterns, module boundaries, refactoring and maintainable code
criteria.engineering: testing, TDD, test quality, SOLID, linting, formatting, construction and project practices
criteria.databases: databases, SQL, NoSQL, indexing, transactions, data modeling, stream processing
criteria.web_frontend: REST APIs, HTTP, WebSocket, CSS, forms, accessibility, visual design and web performance
criteria.devops: Git, rebasing, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud, observability, SRE and reliability
criteria.security: SSH, SQL injection, OWASP, threats, authorization, secure review, privacy and GDPR
criteria.automation: n8n, Hermes, LLM agents, agent SDKs, orchestration, workflows and integration
criteria.frameworks: framework APIs and lifecycle: React, Next.js, Angular, Spring, Django, NestJS and similar libraries

task_type.instructions: What kind of software engineering task does the request ask for?

criteria.question: a question to answer, no change requested
criteria.code_edit: a small, explicit change: rename, text, config value, formatting
criteria.bug_fix: fix behavior that is wrong and reproducible
criteria.architecture: design or evaluate structure across modules or systems
criteria.debugging: investigate a failure whose cause is unknown
criteria.security: find or fix a vulnerability, or change auth, secrets or permissions
criteria.research: explore, compare options or explain code without changing it
criteria.documentation: write or update docs, comments, READMEs or changelogs

scope.instructions: How much of the codebase does the task touch?

criteria.module: several files of one module or package
criteria.multi_repository: more than one repository or service

risk.instructions: How risky is a wrong result?
criteria: low: easy to undo, no user impact
high: data, money, availability or many users affected
critical: production data, security or irreversible operations
clear: the request states what to do
partial: some details must be inferred
open: the goal or approach must be clarified or explored first

reasoning_requirement.instructions: How much reasoning does the task need?
criteria: novel: design or debugging without a known recipe

capability_tier.instructions: What is the cheapest model capability tier likely to solve the task correctly?

criteria.fast: small, fast model: trivial edits, lookups, simple questions
criteria.balanced: mid-size model: ordinary features, fixes and refactors
criteria.strong: large model: subtle bugs, risky or cross-module changes
criteria.frontier: most capable model: novel design, hard debugging, critical systems

reasoning_effort.instructions: How much reasoning effort should the model spend?

criteria.extra_high: exhaustive analysis of a hard problem

agent.instructions: Which specialist should handle the task?

criteria.software-engineer: general implementation tasks that fit no specialist below
criteria.code-reviewer: read-only review of correctness, specification compliance, security and maintainability
criteria.code-simplifier: simplify code while preserving its behavior and contracts
criteria.database-administrator: data architecture, schemas, migrations, query tuning and integrity
criteria.fullstack-engineer: complete vertical features spanning database, backend and frontend
criteria.principal-engineer: cross-team technical strategy, RFCs and engineering guardrails
criteria.product-designer: user journeys, interaction design, visual systems and accessibility
criteria.product-owner: business requirements, backlog refinement and acceptance criteria
criteria.quality-assurance: test strategy, regression automation and release quality verification
criteria.site-reliability-engineer: SLOs, observability, reliability, incidents and error budgets
criteria.tech-lead: delivery decomposition, technical alignment, reviews and engineering standards
criteria.backend-engineer: APIs, services, business rules, queues, server-side code
criteria.frontend-engineer: web UI, components, styling, browser behavior, accessibility
criteria.mobile-engineer: iOS, Android, React Native or Flutter apps
criteria.devops-engineer: CI/CD, builds, containers, infrastructure, deployment, release scripts
criteria.database-engineer: schemas, migrations, queries, indexes, data modeling
criteria.software-architect: system design, module boundaries, cross-cutting architectural decisions
criteria.qa-engineer: writing or fixing tests, test strategy, flaky tests, coverage
criteria.researcher: investigating, comparing options or explaining code without changing it

validation_level.instructions: What validation should confirm the result?

criteria.none: nothing to validate: answers, explanations, plans
criteria.syntax: check formatting or syntax only: docs, config, text
criteria.unit_test: run unit tests of the changed code
criteria.review: careful review of the change: security, architecture, data
